audit_protocol.earliest_cycle_semantics: The preregistered earliest cycle is a trigger floor. Stable physical-relation history is accumulated before the floor and eligibility can become true only at or after the floor.
audit_protocol.formal_requirement: Every Open Drawer relation-loss result must be produced with source-conditioned relation-loss physics v2; earlier rows are invalidated rather than mixed.

ours_result_reuse.rerun_scope: the 33 Native-6 Open Drawer relation-loss source episodes after corrected E1 M5 rows exist
ours_result_reuse.precondition: M5 config, horizon, task wrapper, fault, seed, variation, and success criterion are byte-identical to E1

usage_order: use native6_development.jsonl only for task/fault/result integration
complete every-task 10 nominal plus 10 perturbed development gate
after relation_loss_source_conditioned_physics_v2, archive and rerun the 3 Open Drawer relation-loss development rows per system and rebuild the gate without rewriting old labels
freeze system adapter, checkpoint, environment, services, and configuration
run native6_nominal.jsonl and native6_perturbed.jsonl without further method tuning
return raw episode results and immutable run identities to server A
prohibited: using development episodes as formal results
using one-cup Place Cups as place_cups_3
selecting E6 source episodes from observed success or failure
changing a method or system identity after its first formal E6 episode; public protocol corrections require invalidation and complete rerun of every affected task-by-fault cell
reading fault identity, trigger time, severity, or repair direction inside a policy
